name: hypromellose + naphazoline
uses: Uses temporary relief of redness and discomfort due to: minor eye irritations exposure to wind or sun dryness of the eye prevents further irritation
otcwarn: Do not use if solution changes color or becomes cloudy Ask a doctor before use if you have narrow angle glaucoma Stop use and ask a doctor if you experience eye pain, changes in vision, continued redness or irritation of the eye condition worsens or persists for more than 72 hours
